kind: exploratory audit of already-evaluated frozen pilot; not a fresh untouched confirmatory test
candidate: run-001 seed 0 epoch 10; no training or selection changes
population: all nonempty test episodes in frozen full-v1
primary_target: Observed thermal detections among cells with no detection in any past input bin and at least one observable past scan, restricted to valid future labels. Not independent physical burned-area spread.
secondary_target: Existing latest-state novel mask: P==0 and any past observability
baselines: fixed exp(-distance to P / 2) from trainer
fixed exp(-distance to any past input detection / 2)
metrics: geographic-block mean paired AP difference and bootstrap 95% CI (2000 draws, RNG 0)
support_rule: Primary novel-cell event AP improvement over both distance baselines with geographic-block CI lower bound > 0 at all horizons. Otherwise report failure or inconclusive. No threshold/model tuning.
limits: holdout already evaluated before this audit
thermal episodes not independently confirmed fires
archived publication timing includes stated assumptions
local PyTorch/device differs from original training runtime
